title: rosa rubiginosa var. trachyphylla
intro: Rosa rubiginosa var. trachyphylla, commonly known as Sweet Briar Rose, is a deciduous shrub native to the Mediterranean region, belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rubiginosa var. trachyphylla include reducing inflammation and pain, promoting wound healing, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
